outcome: surgical site infection (SSI) following cesarean section
cohort: Patients who underwent cesarean section between January 2009 and December 2012
finding: While univariate analysis showed an association between SSI and several factors including antibiotic prophylaxis, multivariate analysis only found an association with emergency cesarean, suggesting that prophylaxis may be beneficial only in select groups.
mod_finding: Emergency cesarean section was the only factor independently associated with surgical site infection after adjusting for other risk factors.
